toben.et: From Middle High German toben, from Old High German tobēn, tobōn from Proto-West Germanic *dobēn. Cognate with Middle Low German dōven, Alemannic German tobe.

Tobel.et: Middle High German tobel, from Old High German tobal (“valley, forest ravine”), from Proto-West Germanic *deup (“deep”).

tobsüchtig.et: From Middle High German tobesühtic. Equivalent to Tobsucht + -ig.

Tobsucht.et: From Middle High German tobesuht. By surface analysis, toben + Sucht.
